preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.splitlines()[0]) and all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.splitlines()[1]) and stdin.splitlines()[2].isdigit()
preconditions.description: stdin consists of three lines: first line is integer l (as string), second line is integer r (as string), third line is integer n (as string). All lines are non-empty and contain only digits.
The integer n (length of the output string) is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
The integer l is less than or equal to the integer r.
The integers l and r (as strings) have at most 801 digits each.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines()[0].isdigit() and stdout.splitlines()[1].isdigit() and len(stdout.splitlines()[1]) == int(stdin.splitlines()[2])
postconditions.description: stdout consists of two lines: first line is a non-negative integer (count of modest substrings), second line is a string of length n (the constructed string).

The count of modest substrings in the output string equals the first line of stdout, where count_modest_substrings(s, l, r) is the number of substrings of s that represent integers between l and r (inclusive) without leading zeros.
The output string consists only of digits.

postconditions.expression: not any(s < stdout.splitlines()[1] for s in possible_strings_with_max_count(l, r, n)) or (stdout.splitlines()[1] == min(possible_strings_with_max_count(l, r, n)))
postconditions.description: If there are multiple strings with the maximum count of modest substrings, the lexicographically smallest one is chosen, where possible_strings_with_max_count(l, r, n) is the set of all strings of length n with the maximum count of modest substrings.
